Palm Card

Palm Cards are the workhorse of grassroots outreach. Compact, easy to carry and built for face-to-face moments. Slip a stack in your pocket, bag or clipboard and you're ready for canvassing, tabling, events or handshake-and-go conversations. 

Sized to hand off in seconds without breaking stride, the small format forces clarity: your key point, front and center. These are perfect for campaign walk pieces, event promos, business intros, labor organizations, nonprofit outreach or quick-reference.

Palm cards are the workhorse of grassroots outreach — compact enough to carry in a pocket, bag, or clipboard, and built for face-to-face moments like canvassing, tabling, and quick handshake-and-go conversations. Campaigns, labor organizations, nonprofits, and local businesses order these when they need a fast, low-cost way to hand someone their key message.

Frequently Asked Questions

What sizes do palm cards come in?

We offer seven sizes, from a compact 4 x 6 up to a 4.5 x 11 palm card, each available in one or more stock types. Pick your size and stock combination in the configurator above.

What's the difference between 100#, 14pt AQ, and 14pt UV stock?

100# is an uncoated text-weight stock. 14pt AQ and 14pt UV are heavier card stock with a protective aqueous or UV coating, which holds up better to repeated handling — a common choice for canvassing pieces.

Can Cornerstone design my palm card for me?

Yes. Design services are available as an add-on option per side during checkout — select it before choosing your quantity.

Do you offer a union-printed version for political or labor clients?

Yes — see our Union Palm Card, printed at a union shop with the Allied Printing Trades Council label for clients who need it.

What's the minimum order quantity?

250 palm cards is the minimum order, with quantity breaks up the scale to 25,000.
